name: Thimble Beetle
script:
on tick every 8:
  if mem[0] > 0 then mem[0] -= 1; frame 3; return end
  if rand(10) < 2 then walk to anywhere; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, food) then seek food; eat; say 1
  elif has(neartraits, spooky) then flip; hop 10; say 2; mem[0] = 12
  end
end
on time night: mem[0] = 40; frame 3; emit zzz; end
on poke:
  mem[1] += 1
  if mem[1] % 5 == 0 then say 3; burst heart else hop end
end
on world ants: seek food; sound crunch; end

name: Brass Rain Gauge
script:
on weather rainy: mem[0] = 0; say 1; end
on tick every 20:
  if weather == rainy or weather == stormy then
    mem[0] += 1
    if mem[0] > 3 then mem[0] = 3 end
  elif mem[0] > 0 and rand(4) == 0 then mem[0] -= 1
  end
  frame mem[0] + 1
end
on world leak: mem[0] = 3; frame 4; sound splash; say 2; end
on poke:
  if mem[0] > 0 then emit puff; sound plop; mem[0] -= 1; frame mem[0] + 1
  else say 2 end
end
on bumped: sound ding; hop 4; end

name: Paper Lantern
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on world dark: glow on; frame 2; say 1; signal 7; end
on tick every 12:
  if time == night and rand(6) == 0 then emit sparkle end
  if world == breeze and rand(3) == 0 then flip end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, sleepy) and time == night then emit zzz; say 2 end
end
on poke: glow toggle; sound ding; end
on signal 9: glow on; burst sparkle; end

name: Dandelion Drifter
script:
on tick every 6:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 40 then mem[0] = 0; float 4 end
  if world == breeze and rand(3) == 0 then emit puff; flip end
end
on world breeze: say 1; frame 2; end
on weather stormy: frame 3; say 2; burst puff; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wild) then emit puff end
end
on poke:
  burst puff; float
  mem[1] += 1; frame 1 + mem[1] % 3
end
on time dawn: frame 1; end

name: Acorn Armchair
script:
on near:
  if has(neartraits, sleepy) or has(neartraits, cosy) then
    mem[0] += 1; frame 2; emit zzz
    if mem[0] > 5 then say 1; mem[0] = 0 end
  end
end
on tick every 40:
  if rand(5) == 0 then frame 1 end
  if time == night and rand(3) == 0 then emit zzz end
end
on bumped: sound boing; hop 3; say 2; end
on poke: sound pop; frame 2; emit heart; end
on world visitor: say 1; burst heart; end

name: Chime Flower
script:
on time dawn: frame 2; sound chirp; end
on time night: frame 1; end
on tick every 16:
  if playing and rand(3) == 0 then emit note; frame 2 + rand(2) end
end
on world bloom: frame 3; burst heart; say 1; end
on weather rainy: frame 3; emit sparkle; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, music) then sound tune; say 2; emit note end
end
on poke: sound ding; emit note; signal 4; end
on signal 4: if rand(2) == 0 then emit note; frame 2 end; end

name: Clockwork Mouse
script:
on tick every 4:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1; frame 2 + mem[0] % 2
    if mem[0] == 0 then stop; frame 4; say 2; sound clock end
  end
end
on poke: mem[0] = 30; say 1; sound clock; walk to anywhere; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, clockwork) then face; say 3; emit sparkle
  elif has(neartraits, food) and mem[0] > 0 then seek food; eat
  end
end
on jam jammed: mem[0] = 20; walk to works; sound clock; end
on hour 12: mem[0] = 20; walk to anywhere; end

name: Copper Kettle
script:
on tick every 10:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1; emit puff
    if mem[0] == 1 then frame 3; sound fizz; say 1 end
    if mem[0] == 0 then frame 1 end
  end
end
on time dawn: mem[0] = 12; frame 2; end
on weather snowy: mem[0] = 12; frame 2; say 2; end
on poke:
  if mem[0] == 0 then mem[0] = 8; frame 2; sound pop else burst puff end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, cosy) and mem[0] > 0 then emit heart end
end
on world visitor: mem[0] = 10; frame 2; end

name: Shell Wind Chime
script:
on world breeze: mem[0] = 20; say 1; end
on tick every 3:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1; frame 2 + mem[0] % 2
    if rand(4) == 0 then sound ding; emit note end
    if mem[0] == 0 then frame 1 end
  end
end
on weather stormy: mem[0] = 30; say 2; end
on bumped: mem[0] = 8; sound ding; end
on poke: mem[0] = 6; emit note; end
on signal 4: mem[0] = 4; end
on shipped: if rand(3) == 0 then mem[0] = 3 end; end

name: Soap Jelly
script:
on tick every 8:
  mem[1] += 1; frame 1 + mem[1] % 3
  if rand(30) == 0 then float end
  if zone == water and rand(10) == 0 then emit sparkle end
end
on bumped: burst sparkle; sound pop; say 2; float; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wild) or has(neartraits, spooky) then glow on; say 1; emit puff end
end
on time night: glow on; end
on time day: glow off; end
on weather rainy: burst sparkle; sound splash; end
on poke: glow toggle; emit heart; end

name: Puddle Newt
script:
on weather rainy: walk to water; say 1; frame 2; mem[0] = 1; end
on weather sunny: mem[0] = 0; walk to garden; frame 1; end
on world leak: walk to anywhere; say 2; sound splash; end
on tick every 10:
  if mem[0] == 1 and rand(5) == 0 then hop 4; emit puff
  elif rand(20) == 0 then walk to anywhere
  end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wet) then say 3; emit heart
  elif has(neartraits, noisy) then flip; walk to water
  end
end
on berry: if rand(2) == 0 then seek food; eat end; end
on poke: hop 8; sound plop; end

name: Glowcap
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on tick every 30:
  if time == night and rand(3) == 0 then emit sparkle end
  if days > mem[0] + 2 then mem[0] = days; frame 3; burst sparkle end
end
on world dark: glow on; frame 2; signal 9; say 1; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, spooky) then glow toggle; say 2 end
end
on weather foggy: glow on; emit puff; end
on poke: frame 3; sound fizz; emit sparkle; end

name: Thumb Bookshelf
script:
on hour 21: say 1; emit zzz; end
on tick every 40:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 30 and rand(4) == 0 then mem[0] = 0; frame 2; sound plop; say 2 end
  if mem[0] == 3 then frame 1 end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, sleepy) then emit zzz
  elif has(neartraits, noisy) then say 3; emit puff
  end
end
on bumped: frame 2; sound crunch; say 2; mem[0] = 0; end
on poke: emit heart; frame 2; mem[0] = 0; end
on world visitor: say 1; end

name: Ladybird Nurse
script:
on tick every 12:
  if sulking and mem[0] == 0 then mem[0] = 1; walk to works; say 1 end
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] += 1
    if mem[0] > 6 then nudge; burst heart; say 2; mem[0] = 0 end
  elif rand(15) == 0 then walk to garden; frame 1 + rand(3)
  end
end
on near snail: face; emit heart; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, plant) and rand(3) == 0 then hop 3; emit sparkle end
end
on berry: drop; end
on poke: say 3; hop; end
on time night: emit zzz; stop; end

name: Hanging Birdhouse
script:
on time dawn: fly; sound chirp; say 1; end
on time dusk: home; frame 1; end
on weather rainy: home; say 2; frame 2; end
on tick every 20:
  if time == day and rand(8) == 0 then sound chirp; emit note end
end
on berry: if time == day then fly end; end
on poke:
  if mem[1] == 0 then fly; mem[1] = 1 else home; mem[1] = 0 end
  sound chirp
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, wild) then home; frame 2 end
end
on world visitor: fly; burst note; end

name: Pocket Raincloud
script:
on weather sunny: frame 1; say 1; end
on weather rainy: frame 3; say 2; end
on weather snowy: frame 4; burst sparkle; end
on weather stormy: frame 3; shake; sound bang; say 3; end
on tick every 10:
  if weather == rainy and rand(3) == 0 then emit puff end
  if rand(40) == 0 then float end
end
on world bloom: frame 2; emit heart; end
on poke:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 4 then mem[0] = 0; burst puff; sound whoosh else emit puff end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, plant) and rand(4) == 0 then emit puff end
end

name: Belt Alarm Bell
script:
on jam jammed: mem[0] = 16; say 1; sound bang; end
on jam fixed: mem[0] = 0; frame 1; say 2; burst sparkle; end
on tick every 2:
  if mem[0] > 0 then
    mem[0] -= 1; frame 1 + mem[0] % 2
    if mem[0] % 4 == 0 then sound ding end
  end
end
on shipped:
  mem[1] += 1
  if mem[1] % 10 == 0 then sound coin; burst sparkle; boost 10 end
end
on poke:
  if stuck then mem[0] = 8 else boost; sound horn end
end

name: Sundew Snapper
script:
on near critter:
  frame 2; mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 2 then frame 3; sound crunch; say 1; mem[0] = 0 end
end
on tick every 24:
  if mem[1] > 0 then mem[1] -= 1
  elif rand(6) == 0 then frame 1
  end
  if weather == sunny and rand(5) == 0 then emit sparkle end
end
on berry: drop; say 2; end
on world ants: frame 3; sound crunch; say 3; burst puff; end
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit heart; end
on poke: frame 3; sound crunch; mem[1] = 4; end

name: Toadstool Jukebox
script:
on tick every 8:
  if playing then
    mem[0] += 1; frame 2 + mem[0] % 2
    if rand(4) == 0 then emit note end
  else frame 1 end
end
on hour 20: sound tune; say 1; signal 4; end
on poke: sound tune; burst note; signal 4; say 2; end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, music) then say 3; emit heart
  elif has(neartraits, sleepy) and time == night then emit zzz
  end
end
on world visitor: sound tune; burst note; end
on bumped: sound bang; frame 3; end

name: Burrow Hedgehog
script:
on time night: mem[0] = 1; stop; frame 4; say 1; end
on time dawn: mem[0] = 0; frame 1; say 2; walk to garden; end
on tick every 12:
  if mem[0] == 1 then
    if rand(4) == 0 then emit zzz end
    return
  end
  if berries > 0 and fed < 20 and rand(5) == 0 then seek food; eat; frame 3
  elif rand(10) == 0 then walk to anywhere; frame 1 + rand(2)
  end
end
on bumped:
  if mem[0] == 1 then say 3; hop 2 else frame 4; say 4 end
end
on near:
  if has(neartraits, soft) or has(neartraits, cosy) then emit heart end
end
on poke: if mem[0] == 1 then emit zzz else hop; sound boing end; end
